acceptanceCriteria.criterion: The query text is embedded via Voyage AI using input type 'query' (asymmetric search against document-embedded articles)
A combined Cypher query runs: vector_search.search() for top-K similar nodes, then traverses the graph N hops from each match
Results are returned as a JSON array of {nodeId, type, phase, title, maturity, similarity, relationships[]}
Results are filtered by minSimilarity threshold (default 0.6)
The tool executes in under 3 seconds for typical queries against a populated Memgraph
The module is both a CLI tool (callable via node graph-search.mjs ...) and an importable ES module (exports graphSearch())

package.name: neo4j-driver
package.purpose: Bolt protocol driver for Memgraph (Neo4j-compatible); used for Cypher queries including vector_search.search()

package.name: node-fetch
package.purpose: HTTP client for Voyage AI embedding API calls (or native fetch if Node 18+)

constraints.constraint: Tool must execute in under 3 seconds for typical queries against a populated Memgraph instance
Voyage AI embedding uses model 'voyage-3-large', 1024-dim vectors, input_type 'query' for asymmetric search
Module must work as both CLI (node graph-search.mjs --args) and ES module import (export graphSearch())
Memgraph runs on bolt://localhost:7687 on the EC2 instance; vector index 'knowledge_index' must already exist (Story 1.2)
Results go to stdout as JSON array; timing/debug info goes to stderr (so daemon shell step captureAs gets clean JSON)

interface.signature: async function graphSearch(projectId: string, queryText: string, opts?: { topK?: number, hops?: number, minSimilarity?: number }): Promise<SearchResult[]>
interface.returnType: Array of {nodeId, type, phase, title, maturity, similarity, relationships: Array of {nodeId, type, title, relationship}}

interface.description: Combined vector search + graph traversal Cypher query
interface.query: CALL vector_search.search('knowledge_index', $topK, $queryVector) YIELD node, similarity WHERE similarity > $minSimilarity AND node.projectId = $projectId OPTIONAL MATCH (node)-[r*1..N]-(related) WHERE related.status IN ['active', 'flagged'] RETURN node, similarity, collect(DISTINCT {nodeId, type, title, relationship}) AS related ORDER BY similarity DESC

interface.description: Depends on lib/voyage-embed.mjs from Story 1.4 for embedText(text, inputType) function
